title: Another Baby-friendly recipe of the week
summary: . Crispy Curry Bites are a perfect way to introduce curry flavor to your baby (6 mo+) and to make use of potatoes lying around in your kitchen.
steps: Mash steamed potatoes (2-3 medium-sized potatoes, or about 1 lb total) * Add 4-5 tablespoons of melted butter, 1-3 tablespoons of curry powder, some parsley and mix well * I used piping bag to create fun, bite-sized shapes and also made some alphabet shapes * Air fry for 20 minutes at 400F (if you use oven instead, it will take longer (up to 40 min) to get crispy) These crispy bites are easy to grab (crispy on the outside) but also easy to chew (soft on the inside).
Adults/parents can enjoy them as well – you can add cheese with the mixture before you bake, or eat it with ketchup or sauce of your choice : )
